meta.title: Feature Request System
meta.description: A board of sample feature requests that you can search, filter and vote on, with the form to suggest a new one.
meta.author: cornel.raiu

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

$board_id = \FeatureRequestSystem\Content\RequestTerms::default_term( \FeatureRequestSystem\Content\BoardTaxonomy::NAME );

$page_id = wp_insert_post( [
	'post_type'    => 'page',
	'post_status'  => 'publish',
	'post_title'   => 'Feature requests',
	'post_name'    => 'feature-requests',
	'post_content' => WP_Block_Patterns_Registry::get_instance()->get_registered( \FeatureRequestSystem\Frontend\Blocks::PATTERN )['content'],
] );

\FeatureRequestSystem\Content\BoardSettings::update( $board_id, [ \FeatureRequestSystem\Content\BoardSettings::PAGE => $page_id ] );

$requests = [
	[ 'Dark mode', 'A dark theme for the dashboard and the editor that follows the system setting.', 'open', 42, 30 ],
	[ 'Export requests as CSV', 'Download every request with its votes and status, to share with the team or open in a spreadsheet.', 'planned', 31, 26 ],
	[ 'Slack notifications', 'Post a message in a Slack channel when someone suggests a feature or a status changes.', 'in-progress', 27, 21 ],
	[ 'Two-factor login', 'Ask for a code from an authenticator app when signing in.', 'shipped', 24, 45 ],
	[ 'Keyboard shortcuts', 'Shortcuts for the actions used most, such as search and new request.', 'under-review', 18, 12 ],
	[ 'Custom fields on requests', 'Let people fill in extra fields, such as their plan or company size, when they suggest a feature.', 'open', 12, 9 ],
	[ 'Mobile app', 'An app to vote and follow requests from a phone.', 'open', 6, 4 ],
	[ 'Import from Trello', 'Bring the cards of a Trello board in as requests.', 'declined', 3, 60 ],
];

foreach ( $requests as list( $title, $details, $status, $votes, $days_ago ) ) {
	$date = gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', time() - $days_ago * DAY_IN_SECONDS );
	$id   = wp_insert_post( [
		'post_type'     => \FeatureRequestSystem\Content\RequestPostType::NAME,
		'post_status'   => 'publish',
		'post_title'    => $title,
		'post_content'  => $details,
		'post_date'     => get_date_from_gmt( $date ),
		'post_date_gmt' => $date,
	] );
	wp_set_object_terms( $id, $status, \FeatureRequestSystem\Content\StatusTaxonomy::NAME );
	for ( $i = 0; $i < $votes; $i++ ) {
		\FeatureRequestSystem\Voting\VoteRepository::add( $id, hash( 'sha256', 'demo:' . $id . ':' . $i ), 0 );
	}
	\FeatureRequestSystem\Voting\VoteCount::sync( $id );
}

flush_rewrite_rules();
